info.title: Wenmar Open
info.description: Free vehicle data for auto repair shops: VIN decoding and a year, make, model, submodel and engine catalog. No API key and no account. Responses are plain JSON with no wrapper. Errors are `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details" } }`. Fields and endpoints are only ever added. One address may make 600 requests a minute.

get.summary:
Manufacturer communications, newest first: every one, or those
narrowed by make, model, year, type, component, trouble code, topic or
free text.
get.description: A make or a model the catalog does not have gives an empty list.

parameters.name: make
parameters.description:
Only bulletins that list a vehicle of this make: a name, an alias
or an id, as in `/v1/vehicles/models`.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Only bulletins that list this model: a name or an id. Needs `make`.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Only bulletins that list this model year.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
Only this type: `service_bulletin`, `service_campaign`,
`warranty_extension`, `over_the_air`, `emissions` or `other`.

parameters.name: component
parameters.description:
Only bulletins about this component: an id such as `brakes` or
`brake-pad`.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Only bulletins whose summary names this trouble code.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Only bulletins with this text in them, in either case. At most 100
characters are read.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Only bulletins with this topic. `maintenance` is the only one.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many, up to 100. The default is 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the page before, unchanged.

400.description: `validation_failed`: a query value is wrong, or `model` was given without `make`.

404.description: `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no bulletins.

get.summary:
One manufacturer communication, by NHTSA's id number, with every
vehicle it lists, the components it is about and the trouble codes its
summary names.

parameters.name: nhtsa_id
parameters.description: NHTSA's id number for the communication.

404.description: `not_found`: no bulletin has that id. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no bulletins.

get.summary: The trouble codes that are described, by code.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Only codes with this text in the code, the title or the meaning,
in either case. At most 100 characters are read.

parameters.name: system
parameters.description:
Only this system: `powertrain`, `body`, `chassis` or `network`, or
an area of the powertrain such as `powertrain/emissions`. A group
holds its areas.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many, up to 200. The default is 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the page before, unchanged.

400.description: `validation_failed`: `system` or `cursor` is not one this API knows; `details.field` names it.

404.description: `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no code descriptions.

get.summary: One generic trouble code, described in this project's own words.
get.description:
Only codes every maker uses the same way are described: `P0`, `P2`,
`P3400` and up, `B0`, `C0`, `U0` and `U3`. The text is general and is
not about one make.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: A trouble code, in either case. A longer form such as `P0420:00` is cut to its first five characters.

404.description: `not_found`: the text is not a code, the code is specific to a manufacturer, or nobody has described it yet; the message says which. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no code descriptions.

get.summary:
The repair jobs a labour estimate can be about, in the order of the
list. A job's id never changes.

404.description: `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no job list.

get.summary:
One repair job: what it covers, what it does not, and what it
typically takes by class of vehicle.

parameters.name: job
parameters.description: A job id.

404.description: `not_found`: no job has that id. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no job list.

get.summary: One make, with links to the maker's own pages where they are recorded.

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: A make's id, name or alias.

200.description: The make. `links` is `null` when none are recorded.

404.description: `not_found`: no make has that id.

get.summary: The data version, the vPIC release it came from, and when it was built.

Every model year of one model, newest first, each with its vehicle id
and the number of recall campaigns that may apply to it.

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: A make's id, name or alias.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: A model's id or name.

200.description: The model years. `recalls` is `null` in each when this server holds no recalls.

404.description: `not_found`: no model has that id.

parameters.name: province
parameters.description: Only `ON`, Ontario, for now. Left out, Ontario.

parameters.name: frequency
parameters.description: `weekly`, `biweekly`, `semi-monthly` or `monthly`. Required.

parameters.name: gross
parameters.description: The gross pay for one pay period, in dollars. Required.

parameters.name: federal_claim
parameters.description: The federal claim amount from Form TD1. Left out, the basic personal amount (claim code 1); 0 is claim code 0.

parameters.name: provincial_claim
parameters.description: The Ontario claim amount from Form TD1ON. Left out, the basic personal amount (claim code 1); 0 is claim code 0.

parameters.name: pay_date
parameters.description: The pay date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; it chooses the tables. Left out, today. Send it for an answer that does not depend on the day.

parameters.name: ytd_cpp
parameters.description: CPP (base and first additional) deducted earlier this calendar year. Left out, nothing.

parameters.name: ytd_cpp2
parameters.description: CPP2 deducted earlier this calendar year. Left out, nothing.

parameters.name: ytd_ei
parameters.description: EI deducted earlier this calendar year. Left out, nothing.

parameters.name: ytd_pensionable
parameters.description: Pensionable earnings earlier this calendar year. Left out, nothing.

200.description: The deductions from the pay, the net pay, the employer's share and every T4127 factor used. An estimate.

400.description: `validation_failed`: a field cannot be read, the pay date is outside the tables held, or the province is not Ontario; `details.field` names the field.

get.summary:
Recall campaigns, newest first: every one, or those narrowed by make,
model, year, component, free text or country.
get.description:
Each campaign may apply to the vehicles it lists. A make or a model the
catalog does not have gives an empty list.

parameters.name: make
parameters.description:
Only campaigns that list a vehicle of this make: a name, an alias
or an id, as in `/v1/vehicles/models`.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Only campaigns that list this model: a name or an id. Needs `make`.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Only campaigns that list this model year.

parameters.name: component
parameters.description: Only campaigns whose component text contains this, in either case.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Only campaigns with this text in them, in either case: in the
campaign number, the manufacturer's campaign number, the
manufacturer, the component, the summary, the consequence, the
remedy, the notes, or the make or model of a vehicle listed. At
most 100 characters are read.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: `us` or `ca`. Left out: both, where the server holds both.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many, up to 100. The default is 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the page before, unchanged.

400.description: `validation_failed`: `country`, `year`, `limit` or `cursor` is wrong, or `model` was given without `make`.

404.description: `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no recalls, or none for the country asked for.

get.summary:
Recall campaigns reported on or after a day, newest first, each with
the vehicles it lists.
get.description:
For an application that keeps a list of vehicles: ask once a day with
the day of the last answer, and compare `vehicles[].vehicle_id` with
its own. Each campaign may apply to the vehicles it lists.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description:
Only campaigns reported on or after this day, as `2026-09-01`.
Required.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: `us` or `ca`. Left out: both, where the server holds both.

parameters.name: make
parameters.description:
Only campaigns that list a vehicle of this make: a name, an alias
or an id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many, up to 100. The default is 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the page before, unchanged.

400.description: `validation_failed`: `since` is missing or is not a day, or `country`, `limit` or `cursor` is wrong.

404.description: `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no recalls, or none for the country asked for.

get.summary: One recall campaign with every vehicle it lists.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Who published it: `nhtsa` or `tc` (Transport Canada).

parameters.name: campaign
parameters.description: The publisher's campaign number. Letters may be in either case.

404.description: `not_found`: no campaign has that number. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no recalls from that publisher.

get.summary: The NHTSA investigations that led to a recall campaign.
get.description:
Open and closed, oldest first. Most campaigns followed no investigation
and give an empty list, as every Transport Canada campaign does. The
campaign number is not checked against the recall data.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Who published the campaign: `nhtsa` or `tc` (Transport Canada).

parameters.name: campaign
parameters.description: The publisher's campaign number. Letters may be in either case.

404.description: `not_found`: that is not a campaign number. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no investigations.

get.summary: Engines of a model year, in short form, optionally for one submodel.

parameters.name: submodel
parameters.description: Only engines this submodel comes with.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Only engines whose label starts with this.

get.summary: Makes, popular ones first and the rest by name.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Only makes with a model in this model year.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: `light` (the default), `all`, or a vPIC vehicle type id.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description:
Only makes whose name or alias starts with this. Case and punctuation
are ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many, up to 500.

get.summary: Models of a make, by name. An unknown make has no models.

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: A make's name, alias or id: `Chevrolet`, `chevy` or `chevrolet`.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Only models of this model year.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: `light` (the default), `all`, or a vPIC vehicle type id.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Only models whose name starts with this.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many, up to 500.

get.summary:
Catalog entries for free text, best first. Text that names nothing gives
an empty list.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: What someone would type: `2019 civic si`, `chevy 1500`, `f150`.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: `light` (the default), `all`, or a vPIC vehicle type id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many, up to 50. The default is 10.

get.summary:
Submodels of a model year: trims where NHTSA has them, else series, else
this project's own list.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: A model's name or id: `F-150`, `f150` or `f-150`.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Only submodels whose name starts with this.

get.summary: The same as `/v1/vehicles/submodels`, under the name most people use.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: A model's name or id: `F-150`, `f150` or `f-150`.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Only submodels whose name starts with this.

get.summary: Model years, newest first.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description:
`light` (cars, MPVs and trucks; the default), `all`, or a vPIC
vehicle type id such as `6` for trailers.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Only years that start with this, such as `201`.

get.summary: One catalog entry by its stable id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A vehicle id: year, make and model, then optionally submodel and engine, joined by underscores.

404.description: `not_found`: no vehicle has that id.

get.summary:
Manufacturer communications that list a model year: service bulletins,
service campaigns, warranty extensions and over-the-air updates.
get.description:
One page, newest first; `counts` says how many there are in all and of
what kind, so a caller can offer the narrowings that have something.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A vehicle id. Bulletins are listed by year, make and model; a submodel or an engine in the id is set aside.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
Only this type: `service_bulletin`, `service_campaign`,
`warranty_extension`, `over_the_air`, `emissions` or `other`.

parameters.name: component
parameters.description:
Only bulletins about this component: an id from `counts.components`,
such as `brakes` or `brake-pad`.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description:
Only bulletins whose summary names this trouble code. Letters may
be in either case.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Only bulletins with this text in them, in either case: in the
summary, the manufacturer's document number or campaign id, or the
component. At most 100 characters are read.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Only bulletins with this topic. `maintenance` is the only one.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many, up to 100. The default is 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the page before, unchanged.

200.description: One page of bulletins, newest first.

404.description: `not_found`: no vehicle has that id. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no bulletins.

get.summary:
A trouble code on one model year: its description, the bulletins of
that model year whose summary names it, and the bulletins and recalls
of that model year about the components the description names.
get.description:
Any code answers, a manufacturer-specific one included: such a code has
`description: null` and whatever bulletins name it. `bulletins` and
`related.bulletins` are `null` where bulletins are not held, and
`related.recalls` is `null` where recalls are not. Nothing here says a
recall applies to one vehicle, or what is wrong with it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A vehicle id. A submodel or an engine in the id is set aside.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: A trouble code, in either case.

200.description: What is held about the code for the model year.

404.description: `not_found`: no vehicle has that id, or the text is not a code. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds neither code descriptions nor bulletins.

get.summary:
What owners reported to NHTSA about a model year, as counts by
component.
get.description:
These are owners' reports. They are not verified, and a count is not a
rate. No complaint itself is available here: only how many there are.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A vehicle id. Complaints are counted by year, make and model; a submodel or an engine in the id is set aside.

200.description: The counts. All zero when no complaint names the model year.

404.description: `not_found`: no vehicle has that id. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no complaints.

get.summary: Fluids of a model year.
get.description:
`engine_oil` is the viscosity grade the maker certified the engine
with, as EPA's Fuel Economy Guide records it: not a reading of the
owner's manual, and with no capacity. `engine_oil_checked`,
`transmission`, `coolant`, `refrigerant` and `brake` are records a
person read from the maker's own documents, each with its `source`
and the day it was `checked`. They are empty for a model year nobody
has recorded: nothing is estimated.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A vehicle id.

200.description: The engine oil grades by engine, and the records read by hand.

404.description: `not_found`: no vehicle has that id. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds neither oil grades nor hand-read fluids.

get.summary: Fuel consumption ratings of a model year.
get.description:
EPA's ratings and Natural Resources Canada's, each matched to the
model year. `confidence` says how far: `model`, `engine` or
`submodel`. `engine` is the catalog engine only when the match settled
one. `l_100km` and `mpg` (US gallons) are the same figures in two
units; both are null for a fuel not sold by the litre.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A vehicle id. Ratings are listed by year, make and model; a submodel or an engine in the id is set aside.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description:
`us` for EPA's ratings, `ca` for Natural Resources Canada's.
Leave out for both.

200.description: The ratings, EPA's first, each by engine size.

404.description: `not_found`: no vehicle has that id. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no fuel ratings, or none for the country asked for.

get.summary: NHTSA investigations that list a model year.
get.description:
By default only the open ones about a possible defect in the vehicles
listed. An investigation is not a finding that a defect exists, and it
lists a year, make and model, never one vehicle: `note` says so.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A vehicle id. Investigations are listed by year, make and model; a submodel or an engine in the id is set aside.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
`open` (the default): only investigations that are open and about a
possible defect in the vehicles they list. `all`: every
investigation that lists the model year, closed ones and audit
queries included.

200.description: The investigations, newest first. An empty list when none lists the model year.

404.description: `not_found`: no vehicle has that id. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no investigations.

get.summary:
Labour estimates for a model year: for each job, the hours of the
narrowest scope that has a figure, and which scope that was.
get.description:
An estimate, not a quote. `scope` says what a figure is for: `class` is
typical for vehicles of that class and was not worked out on this one.
An id that ends with an engine asks for that engine.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A vehicle id. An engine in the id narrows the answer to it.

200.description: One estimate for each job that has a figure covering the vehicle.

404.description: `not_found`: no vehicle has that id. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no labour estimates.

get.summary:
The labour estimate of one job for a model year. `estimates` has one
entry, or none when no figure covers the vehicle.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A vehicle id.

parameters.name: job
parameters.description: A job id.

200.description: The estimate, when there is one.

404.description: `not_found`: no vehicle, or no job, has that id. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no labour estimates.

get.summary: Everything held for a model year, in one answer.
get.description:
A block this server has no data for is `null`. The `recalls` block
counts the campaigns that may apply to the year, make and model; it is
not a lookup by VIN.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A vehicle id. The overview is of the year, make and model; a submodel or an engine in the id is set aside.

404.description: `not_found`: no vehicle has that id.

get.summary: Recalls that may apply to a model year.
get.description:
The list is for the year, make and model. It is not a lookup by VIN:
`may_apply` is always `true`, and `lookup` gives the official addresses
where a VIN can be checked.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A vehicle id. Recalls are listed by year, make and model; a submodel or an engine in the id is set aside.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: `us` or `ca`. Left out: both, where the server holds both.

200.description: Recalls that may apply, newest first.

404.description: `not_found`: no vehicle has that id. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no recalls, or none for the country asked for.

get.summary: NHTSA's crash test ratings for a model year.
get.description:
NHTSA rates by body style and drive, so `ratings` often has several
entries and their stars can differ: each says which vehicle it is for,
in NHTSA's words. An entry with no stars is a vehicle NHTSA lists and
has not tested. `ratings` is empty when NHTSA lists none for the model
year.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A vehicle id. Ratings are listed by year, make and model; a submodel or an engine in the id is set aside.

200.description: Every rating NHTSA gave a vehicle of the model year.

404.description: `not_found`: no vehicle has that id. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no crash test ratings.

get.summary: Specifications of a model year from EPA's files.
get.description:
One entry per EPA rating: transmission and gears, drive, recommended
fuel, forced induction, stop-start, cylinder deactivation, valves,
passenger and luggage volume, hybrid battery, and the emission
standards it was certified to. A field EPA does not give is null.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A vehicle id.

404.description: `not_found`: no vehicle has that id. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no specifications.

get.summary: Original-equipment tire fitments of a model year.
get.description:
Every size the maker fitted that a person has recorded, each with the
trims it covers, the cold pressures, the wheel nut torque and the bolt
pattern, the document it was read from (`source`) and the day
(`checked`). A model year usually has several; none is picked. An
empty list means nobody has recorded this model year, not that it has
no tires on file anywhere.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A vehicle id. Fitments are listed by year, make and model; a submodel or an engine in the id is set aside.

200.description: The fitments, in the order they were recorded.

404.description: `not_found`: no vehicle has that id. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no tire fitments.

post.description:
The answer is an array in the order asked. Each item is a decode, or the
error object a single request for that VIN would have returned.

With `?include=recalls`, each decode that reaches a model year of the
catalog also carries `recalls`: how many campaigns may apply to that
model year. It is a count for the year, make and model, never a lookup
by VIN.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description:
`recalls` adds to each decode the number of recall campaigns that
may apply to the model year it reaches. Left out: nothing is added.

200.description: One item per VIN, in order.

400.description: `validation_failed`: the body is not `{ "vins": [...] }` or lists more than 50, or `include` is not `recalls`.

404.description: `dataset_unavailable`: `include=recalls` was asked of a server that holds no recalls.

get.summary: Decode one VIN.
get.description:
Spaces and dashes in the VIN are ignored and letters may be in either
case. A wrong check digit is not an error: `valid` is `false` and a
warning says so.

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: A 17-character VIN.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Use this model year instead of working it out from the VIN.

400.description: `invalid_vin`: wrong length or illegal characters. `details.suggestions` lists likely corrections.

404.description: `not_found`: no manufacturer is registered for the first three characters.

get.summary:
Manufacturer communications that list the year, make and model a VIN
decodes to.
get.description:
A VIN that decodes to no vehicle in the catalog gets an empty list and
the warning `no_catalog_vehicle`, not an error.

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: A 17-character VIN.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Use this model year instead of working it out from the VIN.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
Only this type: `service_bulletin`, `service_campaign`,
`warranty_extension`, `over_the_air`, `emissions` or `other`.

parameters.name: component
parameters.description:
Only bulletins about this component: an id such as `brakes` or
`brake-pad`.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Only bulletins whose summary names this trouble code.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Only bulletins with this text in them, in either case. At most 100
characters are read.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Only bulletins with this topic. `maintenance` is the only one.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many, up to 100. The default is 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the page before, unchanged.

200.description: One page of bulletins, newest first.

404.description: `not_found`: no manufacturer is registered for the first three characters. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no bulletins.

get.summary: Fluids for the vehicle a VIN decodes to.
get.description:
When the decode settles the engine, `engine_oil` holds the one entry
of that engine, or none, and each hand-read list holds the records of
that engine and those recorded for every engine. Otherwise each holds
every engine's.

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: A 17-character VIN.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The model year, when the VIN's tenth character leaves two possible.

200.description: The engine oil grades and the records read by hand.

404.description: `not_found`: no manufacturer is registered for the first three characters. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds neither oil grades nor hand-read fluids.

get.summary: Fuel consumption ratings for the vehicle a VIN decodes to.
get.description:
When the decode settles the engine, `engine_settled` is `true` and
`ratings` holds only the ratings matched to that engine. Otherwise it
holds every rating of the model year, as the vehicle route does.

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: A 17-character VIN.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: `us` or `ca`. Leave out for both.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The model year, when the VIN's tenth character leaves two possible.

404.description: `not_found`: no manufacturer is registered for the first three characters. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no fuel ratings, or none for the country asked for.

get.summary:
Labour estimates for the vehicle a VIN decodes to. When the decode
settles the engine, an engine-scope figure can answer.

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: A 17-character VIN.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The model year, when the VIN's tenth character leaves two possible.

200.description: The estimates. `vehicle` is `null` and `estimates` empty when the VIN reaches no catalog vehicle.

404.description: `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no labour estimates.

get.summary: The labour estimate of one job for the vehicle a VIN decodes to.

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: A 17-character VIN.

parameters.name: job
parameters.description: A job id.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The model year, when the VIN's tenth character leaves two possible.

200.description: The estimate, when there is one.

404.description: `not_found`: no job has that id. `dataset_unavailable`: this server holds no labour estimates.

get.summary: Everything held for the model year a VIN decodes to, in one answer.
get.description:
The VIN only names the model year: `recalls` counts the campaigns that
may apply to it, and no public data says a recall applies to one VIN. A
VIN that decodes to no vehicle in the catalog gets `vehicle: null`,
every block `null` and the warning `no_catalog_vehicle`, not an error.

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: A 17-character VIN.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Use this model year instead of working it out from the VIN.

404.description: `not_found`: no manufacturer is registered for the first three characters.

get.summary: The parts-ordering card for a VIN.
get.description:
What a parts counter asks for, one line each, and where each line came
from: the decode, the catalog engine when the decode settles it, the
emission standard when EPA's file was matched to that engine, and the
build dates a recall campaign names for the model year. A build-date
line is the range a campaign covers, not this vehicle's build date.
`text` is the card as plain text, ready to paste. Works without shop
data: the lines that need it are then left off.

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: A 17-character VIN.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The model year, when the VIN's tenth character leaves two possible.

404.description: `not_found`: no manufacturer is registered for the first three characters.

get.summary: Recalls that may apply to the year, make and model a VIN decodes to.

empty list and the warning `no_catalog_vehicle`, not an error.

SafetyFeatures.description:
The safety features NHTSA lists with a rating. A feature is `standard`,
`optional`, `both` (standard on some versions, optional on others) or
`no`. An evaluation is `meets`, `does_not_meet`, `standard_only`,
`upgrade_only` or `pending`. `null` where NHTSA's file does not say.

For the four driver-assistance features (forward collision warning,
lane departure warning, crash imminent braking, dynamic brake support)
NHTSA's file means two things by its years. Through model year 2022,
`standard`, `optional` and `both` say the feature is fitted and met
NHTSA's performance criteria, `no` says it is not fitted or did not
meet them, and there is no evaluation. From model year 2023 the value
says only whether the feature is fitted, and the evaluation says what
NHTSA's test found.

release.description:
1 for the first release of a model year; 2 or 3 for a later one
that NHTSA rated again.

rollover_risk_percent.description: The chance of a rollover in a single-vehicle crash, in percent.

rollover_tip.description: Whether the vehicle tipped up in NHTSA's dynamic test.

SafetyStars.description:
The stars of one rating, each from 1 to 5. `null` where NHTSA gave
none: a test it did not run, or a rating older than the overall rating,
which began with model year 2011.

side_driver.description: The side barrier test: the driver, and the rear passenger.

side_front_seat.description: The front seat and the rear seat, over the barrier and pole tests.

Selection.description: The catalog's answer for one decoded VIN.

engine_id.description: The engine's id form, when the decode settles on one.

entry.description: The most specific entry the decode reaches.

submodel_id.description: The submodel's id form, when the decode names exactly one.

vehicle_id.description: The id of the year, make and model.

Spec.description: The specifications that come with one EPA rating.

confidence.description: `model`, `engine` or `submodel`, as on a fuel rating.

cylinder_deactivation_name.description: The maker's name for it, such as `Active Fuel Management`.

electrification.description: EPA's kind of alternative powertrain: `Hybrid`, `Plug-in Hybrid`, `EV`, `FFV`, `Diesel`.

fuel_usage.description: Whether the grade is recommended or required, in EPA's words.

motor_kw.description: Rated motor power in kW, as EPA's file writes it: `135`, `8 and 30`.

SpecEmission.description: An emission standard a vehicle was certified to.

sales_area.description:
EPA's sales area code, a number. EPA's column list does not say
what each number means, so no name is given.

Submodel.description: A submodel: a trim, or a series where the data has no trim.

kind.description:
`trim` or `series` as NHTSA has it, or `preset` from this project's
own list.

TireFitment.description:
One tire size the maker fitted to a model year, read by a person from
the door placard or the owner's manual.

oneOf.description: Cold pressure in kilopascals. `null` when none is recorded.
The same in pounds per square inch.

pressure_written_in.description:
The unit the document printed: `kpa`, `bar` or `psi`. The other
figures were worked out from it.

size.description: The size as printed. The front size when `size_rear` is given.

size_rear.description: The rear size, only when it differs from the front.

trims.description:
The trims the document ties the size to, as it names them. Empty
when it names none.

VehicleBulletins.description: Bulletins that list one model year.

as_of.description: The day the bulletins were current.

attribution.description: The credit lines the data's licences ask for.

next_cursor.description: Pass it back as `cursor` for the next page. `null` on the last.

note.description: What a bulletin is and is not.

VehicleCode.description: A trouble code on one model year.

oneOf.description:
`null` where bulletins are not held: they are on the hosted
service only.

`null` when the code is not generic, when nobody has described it,
or where descriptions are not held.

generic.description:
Whether every maker uses the code the same way. A code that is not
generic is never described, and may still be named by bulletins.

url.description: The page of this code on this model year.

VehicleComplaints.description: What owners reported to NHTSA about one model year, as counts.

as_of.description: The day the complaints were current.

complaints.description:
Every complaint about the model year. Not a rate: a model that
sold more has more.

components.description:
The components with at least five complaints, most first, at most
twelve. They do not add up to `complaints`: a complaint may name
several, and a part is counted under its system too.

note.description: What these counts are and are not.

report_url.description: Where an owner files a complaint with NHTSA.

verified.description:
Always `false`. A complaint is an owner's report. Nobody has
verified it, and a count of complaints is not a finding that
anything is wrong with the vehicle.

VehicleFluids.description:
The fluids of one model year.

`engine_oil` is the grade EPA records. The five lists after
`checked_as_of` are records a person read from the maker's own
documents, each with its `source` and the day it was `checked`; they
are empty for a model year nobody has recorded, and on a server that
does not hold the records `checked_as_of` is `null`.

as_of.description:
The day EPA's oil grades were current. `null` on a server without
them.

checked_as_of.description:
The day of the newest hand-read record the server holds, for any
vehicle. `null` on a server without them.

VehicleFuel.description: The fuel ratings of one model year.

VehicleInvestigations.description: NHTSA investigations that list one model year.

as_of.description: The day NHTSA's investigation file was current.

attribution.description: The credit lines the data's licence asks for.

investigations.description: Newest first. Empty when none lists the model year.

note.description:
That an investigation is not a finding of a defect and is not about
one vehicle. Show it wherever the list is shown.

VehicleLabor.description:
Labour estimates for one model year: for each job, the figure of the
narrowest scope that has one.

as_of.description: The newest day an estimate was changed.

oneOf.description:
`null` when the model year has no class: no class-scope figure
reaches it.

engine.description:
The engine the vehicle id named, as an id form. `null` when it
named none: no engine-scope figure can then answer.

estimates.description:
One for each job that has a figure covering the vehicle, in the
order of the job list.

VehicleRecalls.description: Recalls that may apply to one model year.

attribution.description: The credit lines the data's licences ask for.

may_apply.description:
Always `true`. A campaign lists a year, make and model; only the
manufacturer can say whether one vehicle is in it. Check the VIN at
the addresses in `lookup`.

recalls.description: Newest first. Empty when none was found as of the dates in `as_of`.

VehicleSafety.description: NHTSA's crash test ratings for one model year.

as_of.description: The day NHTSA's file was current.

attribution.description: The credit lines the data's licence asks for. NHTSA's asks for none.

ratings.description:
One entry for each vehicle of the model year NHTSA rated or lists,
by NHTSA's model name, body style and drive. Empty when it lists
none.

VehicleSpecs.description: The specifications of one model year.

VehicleTires.description: Every original-equipment tire fitment on record for one model year.

as_of.description: The day of the newest record the server holds, for any vehicle.

fitments.description:
One entry per size, in the order of the record file. Empty for a
model year nobody has recorded. A size is never picked for the
caller.

VinBulletins.description: Bulletins that list the year, make and model a VIN decodes to.

oneOf.description: `null` when the VIN decodes to no vehicle in the catalog.

VinDecode.description: A decoded VIN. A field that could not be determined is left out.

base_price_usd.description: Manufacturer base price in US dollars, when NHTSA has one.

oneOf.description:
The catalog entry this VIN reaches, for prefilling a vehicle form.
Left out when the catalog cannot place the vehicle.

gvwr.description: Gross vehicle weight rating class, as NHTSA words it.

oneOf.description:
How many recall campaigns may apply to the model year. Only in a
batch asked with `include=recalls`, and only when the VIN reaches a
model year of the catalog.

valid.description:
Whether the check digit, position 9, is right. Many genuine VINs from
outside North America fail it.

warnings.description: Things to know about a decode that still succeeded.

VinFluids.description: The fluids for the vehicle a VIN decodes to.

engine_oil_checked.description: Narrowed as `engine_oil` is. A record for every engine is kept.

VinFuel.description: The fuel ratings for the vehicle a VIN decodes to.

oneOf.description: The engine the decode settled. Null when it settled none.
Null when the VIN decodes to no vehicle in the catalog.

VinLabor.description: Labour estimates for the vehicle a VIN decodes to.

oneOf.description: `null` when the VIN decodes to no vehicle in the catalog.

VinRecallCount.description:
What a batch decode says of recalls when `include=recalls` is asked:
how many campaigns may apply to the model year the VIN decodes to.

do_not_drive.description: Whether any of them carries NHTSA's advisory not to drive.

may_apply.description:
Always `true`. The count is for the year, make and model, not for
the VIN: check the VIN at the addresses in `lookup`.

park_outside.description: Whether any of them carries NHTSA's advisory to park outside.

VinRecalls.description: Recalls that may apply to the year, make and model a VIN decodes to.

may_apply.description:
Always `true`. This is not a lookup by VIN: the list is for the
model year, and the VIN only names it.

oneOf.description:
The model year the recalls are for. `null` when the VIN does not
decode to a vehicle in the catalog; `recalls` is then empty and a
warning says so.

warnings.description:
The decode's warnings, and `no_catalog_vehicle` when the VIN names
no model year to list recalls for.

VinSpecs.description: The specifications for the vehicle a VIN decodes to.

VinTires.description: The tire fitments of the model year a VIN decodes to.

fitments.description:
Every fitment of the model year. A VIN does not say which wheels a
vehicle left the factory with, so the list is never narrowed.

suggestions.description: VINs the caller may have meant.

tags.name: Vehicles
tags.description: Years, makes, models, submodels and engines, each step limited to what is valid for the steps before it.

tags.name: Recalls
tags.description: Recall campaigns from NHTSA and Transport Canada that may apply to a model year. Never a lookup by VIN: confirm with the manufacturer.

tags.name: Investigations
tags.description: NHTSA defect investigations that list a model year or led to a recall. An investigation is not a finding of a defect.

tags.name: Bulletins
tags.description: Manufacturer communications NHTSA publishes: service bulletins, service campaigns, warranty extensions and over-the-air updates, by model year. NHTSA's index and summary only; the document is linked at NHTSA.

tags.name: Complaints
tags.description: What owners reported to NHTSA about a model year, as counts by component. Reports, not verified defects; counts, not rates.

tags.name: Codes
tags.description: Generic OBD-II trouble codes, described in this project's own words, and what is held about a code for one model year. Manufacturer-specific codes are not described.

tags.name: Labour
tags.description: Wenmar's own estimates of the hours a repair job takes, by job and vehicle, under CC BY 4.0. An estimate, not a quote, and never taken from a labour guide. Each figure says what it is for: an engine, a run of model years, a model, or a class of vehicle.

tags.name: Payroll
tags.description: Ontario payroll deductions for one pay by CRA's T4127 formulas (Option 1): income tax, CPP, CPP2 and EI, the net pay and the employer's share, with every factor used. An estimate: the employer remains liable to CRA for what it deducts and remits; check with CRA's Payroll Deductions Online Calculator (PDOC).
